pr_title: stm32 enables  HSI48 fixed clock with device tree
pr_body:
Until now the HSI 48 clock of the stm32 mcu is enabled by the peripheral that needs it with LL_RCC_HSI48_Enable
With this PR, it is defined by the DeviceTree for each stm32 that needs it.
As the frequency is fixed at 48MHz, it is not required by the DTS to specify the value.

New sequence added in the stm32_clock_configuration/stm32_common_core/  testcase to check that HSI48 is ready when required.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/49870

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu <francois.ramu@st.com>
pr_comments:
For the STM32F0 serie : F04x, F07x, F09x devices only have the HSI48.
Enabling HSI48 clock for the sensortile_box board  (for USB).
Enabling HSI48 clock for the nccleo_wb55rg board (for Bluetooth)
Add comment : the HSI48 enable part is kept for legacy but should be removed later and be configured exclusively by the DTS

Enabling &clk_hsi48 node for all the boards with stm32 RNG or USB or SDMMC or BLE peripheral enabled : 
stm32F0, stm32G0, stm32G4, stm32H7, stm32L0, stm32L4, stm32L5, stm32U5, stm32WB

issue_context.title: stm32 enables HSI48 clock with device tree
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Until now the HSI 48 clock of the stm32 mcu is enabled by the peripheral that needs it with LL_RCC_HSI48_Enable


**Describe the solution you'd like**
Use the Device tree to enable the HSI48 clock by the clock_control driver.

review_comments: Should you manage hsem here too ?
The CFG_HW_CLK48_CONFIG_SEMID is already locked/unlocked by the RNG or USB driver in that particular case when required (not twice)

This should be done in a dedicated commit, at least not this one.
Also, same is required for other series as well.
